verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a single API call creates a virtual or physical card (lithic-docs-9/25) and that a full sandbox mirrors production for cards/transactions/webhooks (lithic-docs-15, lithic-docs-5/19), supporting the sandbox-to-production workflow. However, the pack never explicitly states that PAN, CVV, and expiry are returned synchronously in the create-card response, nor does it document a self-serve signup path avoiding a sales cycle. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that PAN/CVV/expiry are returned in the same API call, and evidence of self-serve account creation without a sales process.
